# ESM3 Academy

> A comprehensive learning platform for ESM3, a cutting-edge AI model for protein and genomic analysis with applications across biomedical, genomics, and industrial sectors.

ESM3 Academy provides tutorials, documentation, and resources for users ranging from beginners to advanced practitioners. The platform covers product fundamentals, practical use cases, developer tools, and best practices for working with ESM3's APIs and SDKs.

## Key Topics

- ESM3
- ESM3 API
- ESM3 SDKs
- PyTorch
- CUDA
- Getting Started
- Use Cases
- Best Practices
- Performance Optimization
- Advanced Techniques
- Biomedical Applications
- Developer Tools
- Tutorials
- Architecture
- Community Support

## Getting Started

- [Unlocking ESM3 for Everyone](https://esm3academy.com): ESM3 Academy homepage with tutorials, resources, and learning paths
- [About ESM3](https://esm3academy.com/about-esm3): Overview of ESM3 product features, architecture, and capabilities
- [Tutorials](https://esm3academy.com/tutorials): Beginner to advanced ESM3 tutorials covering installation and deployment

## Core Concepts & Applications

- [Use Cases](https://esm3academy.com/use-cases): ESM3 applications in biomedical, genomics, and industrial sectors
- [Best Practices](https://esm3academy.com/best-practices): ESM3 best practices for data management, reproducibility, and compliance

## Developer Resources

- [Developer Tools](https://esm3academy.com/developer-tools): ESM3 API, SDKs, and developer resources for integration and automation
- [Advanced Techniques](https://esm3academy.com/advanced-techniques): Advanced ESM3 methods including fine-tuning and performance optimization
- [test code block](https://esm3academy.com/test-code-block): ESM3 code tutorial with PyTorch, CUDA, and multi-GPU training examples

## Support & Community

- [FAQs & Help Center](https://esm3academy.com/faqs-help-center): ESM3 installation, troubleshooting, and performance optimization help
- [Community News](https://esm3academy.com/community-news): ESM3 updates, product releases, research highlights, and community events
